body:
🎮 Strawbxnny - Your Pokémon adventure in Minecraft starts here! 🎮

Explore the world of Cobblemon like never before in Strawbxnny! This server is designed to offer you the ultimate Pokémon experience in Minecraft, with ALL Pokémon available and a welcoming community ready to help you on your journey.

Join us in kanto.strawbxnny.com

✨ Key features:

Exclusive modpack for an optimized experience

Compatible with the latest version of Cobblemon

Catch, train, trade, and battle with your favorite Pokémon!

Weekly events, challenges, gyms, and much more

🗺️ Are you ready to become the best trainer?

Install the modpack, join the server, and become part of Strawbxnny, where your Pokémon adventure awaits. 🌸
